notes.title: 📦 Box Clicker Beta Access Update
notes.notes:
An update for Beta Access 📦 Box Clicker has been released.


 Launching the game now takes place in a window.
 Added the ability to resize the game window.
 Added sound on/off button.
 Added full screen/window mode button.
 Updated item descriptions in Steam.
 Small fixes.
